workflow_review.decision: Appropriate for exploratory development-only retrieval pilot, with these limitations
workflow_review.muSiQue: 24 questions, 8 each of 2/3/4 hops: report each stratum and do not treat pooled score as population estimate. Exclude prior qids; inspect shared single-hop component IDs and record overlap. No hard assurance of unseen text, since documents can be reused.
workflow_review.quality: 12 questions, 6 hard and 6 non-hard, each from a distinct article and excluding all five previously read article IDs. Keep all questions of those articles in development/exposure group. No native gold evidence spans; retrieval recall must remain null.
workflow_review.comparison: Keep identical chunking and final top-5 retrieval policy; record actual min(50,N) candidate counts. This is an adapter/pilot check, not a formally equivalent 50-candidate comparison for native 17-20-paragraph inputs.
workflow_review.quality_policy: Retain the predetermined sample and denominator. Mark annotation concerns without silently substituting or excluding questions after seeing outputs.
workflow_review.reporting: No paid API or generated answer metrics if only retrieval is run. Exposure register is tracking, not enforcement until code checks it.
